description: Search EU legislation — regulations, directives, decisions — held in Ortexo (31,839 acts, each in its applicable version) in their ROMANIAN versions. Write the query in Romanian: the search is semantic plus full-text, and the full-text half matches Romanian words only, so an English query is matched by meaning alone and ranks lower. Naming the act ("GDPR", "Regulamentul 2016/679") or an article of it ("articolul 17 din GDPR") puts it first. Returns the article text with its CELEX. When the answer turns on a DIRECTIVE, follow up with eu_transposition to find the Romanian act that implements it — a directive applies in Romania through that act, so the directive alone is an incomplete answer.

query.description: What you are looking for, in Romanian — a subject, an act's name, or an article of it.

name: search_eu_law
